assumptions: The unit roundoff u is nonnegative.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p05_t2_square_lu_backward_error {n : Nat} ... : exists DeltaA, LU=A+DeltaA and |DeltaA_ij| <= i*u*(|L||U|)_ij and |DeltaA_ij| <= (n-1)*u*(|L||U|)_ij
formal_statement.plain_language: The square Doolittle residuals assemble into the exact LU backward error with both the sharp rowwise and uniform (n-1)u bounds.

informal_proof: Set DeltaA=LU-A, retain the local rowwise bounds, and use i<=n-1 together with nonnegativity of |L||U| to obtain the uniform estimate.
informal_statement: The square-case sharpening of Theorem 4.2 and equation (4.2).
